Tamagotchi Emulation Resources

First off, here's a Tamagotchi Paradise Growth Chart that I edited, which combines Jade Forest, White Glacier, and Tropical growth charts into one image:

  • TamaWeb - play a tamagotchi-inspired fangame in your browser, on your PC, or your Android!
  • TamaEmu for Web - runs the P's, iDL/E, 4U, 4U+, and Plus Color ROMs.
  • TamaEmu for Android - Same program as above, adapted to run on an Android device.
  • T18Emu - An emulator for Tamagotchi On. Currently only works with English ROMs.

Now, you're probably wondering, where do you get ROMs, anyway? And you can't ask anywhere, it seems. Well, hopefully I am not breaking the internet by saying that you can find them on the internet archive. Please use this information responsibly.
